title: How Far Can Coding Agents Go in Visual Generation?
abstract: arXiv:2610.19025v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern image generation largely relies on specialized generative models that leave the process of image construction implicit in learned parameters. We explore an alternative: general-purpose coding agents that construct images through executable programs. Our study of zero-shot drawing on AgentDrawBench, a 200-prompt benchmark, reveals a distinctive capability profile. Agents excel at preserving structure and satisfying precise visual constraints, achieving competitive results in domains where compositional accuracy matters more than photorealistic appearance, while remaining limited in perceptual richness. Their visual expressiveness varies with the drawing interface, and a qualitative study on reconstruction shows how procedural skills extracted from human demonstrations support different artistic media. We then examine code as an external visual language of thought: a structured, executable representation that agents can construct

translated_title: 编程智能体在视觉生成中能走多远？
translated_abstract: 现代图像生成在很大程度上依赖于专门的生成模型，这些模型将图像构建过程隐式地嵌入在学习到的参数中。我们探索了一种替代方案：通过可执行程序来构建图像的通用编程智能体。我们在 AgentDrawBench（一个包含200个提示词的基准测试）上对零样本绘图的研究揭示了一种独特的能力特征。智能体擅长保持结构并满足精确的视觉约束，在构图准确性比照片级真实外观更重要的领域取得了有竞争力的结果，但在感知丰富性方面仍然有限。它们的视觉表现力随绘图界面的不同而变化，一项关于重构的定性研究展示了从人类演示中提取的程序化技能如何支持不同的艺术媒介。随后，我们考察了代码作为一种外部视觉思维语言：一种智能体可以构建的结构化、可执行的表示。
tldr: 该研究通过AgentDrawBench基准发现，通用编程智能体通过编写可执行程序生成图像时，擅长保持结构和满足精确视觉约束，在构图准确性重要的领域表现具有竞争力，但在感知丰富性上仍有局限。
en_tdlr: This study introduces AgentDrawBench and finds that general-purpose coding agents, which construct images through executable programs, excel at preserving structure and satisfying precise visual constraints, achieving competitive results in compositional accuracy domains while remaining limited in perceptual richness.
